title: AndroidAPS failed to get Juggluco readings without any errors
symptom: AndroidAPS had not had blood glucose readings for 481 minutes, while Juggluco was working correctly. The issue was fixed by force closing and restarting AndroidAPS, suggesting it locked up somewhere.
cause: WorkManager stopped working, possibly due to low system resources in the phone.
fix: Force closing AndroidAPS and restarting it resolved the issue temporarily.
evidence_quote: I fixed the issue by force closing AndroidAPS and restarting, so I suspect it locked up sonewhere.
